src/llm-generation-checks.ts.name: Answer checks
src/llm-generation-checks.ts.description: Checks a request against what the chosen connection can do, and checks each streamed and final answer follows the protocol.

src/llm-service.ts.name: AI chat service
src/llm-service.ts.description: Answers napplet AI requests: lets the user pick a connection, asks consent, calls the provider and streams the answer back.

src/llm-types.ts.name: AI message shapes and errors
src/llm-types.ts.description: Defines the AI domain name, its error codes, reply shapes and the error type the service raises.
